strings.name: Cao Dewang
strings.summary: Cao's family fell into poverty during his childhood. He left junior secondary school unfinished and learned through self-study and trading. He co-founded Fuyao Glass in 1987, expanding automotive glass production, stock-market listings and overseas plants within global supply chains. A documentary examined labor and cultural conflicts at its US plant. He also supports charity and engineering education, becoming lifetime honorary chairman after leaving the chairmanship in 2025.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, not a live news archive.
